verdict.rationale: The skills are published as plain SKILL.md files in a public repository, so their instructions can be read at known paths (docs-4, docs-14, docs-16). The README also documents validating an unpublished checkout in an isolated configuration directory before normal installation (docs-2), and says differing customized or unrecorded installed copies are flagged for review rather than silently deleted (docs-3). However, no documented command lists a skill's files or scripts before installing, and nothing describes inspecting every installed file afterward. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install listing of skill contents including scripts, a documented post-install way to view all installed files, and hands-on corroboration.
